name: Crontab Enumeration
description: Detects usage of crontab -l to list the current user's scheduled tasks, a common reconnaissance step. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_crontab_enumeration.yml, hand-converted from Sigma.
query: any where process.executable like~ "*/crontab" and process.title like~ "* -l*"
author: Sentinel
